properties.title: Russian missile strike on Kyiv arms exhibition
properties.summary: Russian ballistic missile struck arms exhibition near Kyiv July 24, killing 11. Russia confirmed deliberate targeting.

properties.title: US-Saudi strikes on Iran-aligned groups in Iraq
properties.summary: US and Saudi Arabia struck Iran-backed groups in Iraq July 29. At least 20 killed. Khormur gas field also attacked.

properties.title: Iran ballistic missile attack on US base in Jordan
properties.summary: IRGC launched multiple ballistic missiles at US airbase in Jordan. US military intercepted the barrage. First escalation after five-day pause.

properties.title: M7.1 Kumamoto earthquake — 13 dead
properties.summary: Magnitude 7.1 struck Kumamoto, Japan. Aeon Mall partially collapsed. 300,000 evacuated. 1.2M in MMI 7+ zone.

properties.title: Ukraine Caspian Sea drone strike on Iranian vessel
properties.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Iranian vessel in Caspian Sea carrying drone/missile components. One sailor killed. Iran threatened retaliation.

properties.title: Belgorod drone attack — 3 killed
properties.summary: Drone attacks killed 3 people including targeting a bus in Russia Belgorod region July 29.

properties.title: Drone raids in Moscow region
properties.summary: Drone raids in Koledino and Chekhov districts of Moscow Oblast July 28. Explosions reported.

properties.title: Pakistan-Afghanistan conflict — 499 Afghan civilians killed
properties.summary: UN UNAMA documented 499 Afghan civilians killed since October 2025 in cross-border fighting. Pakistan declared open war February 2026.

properties.title: Saudi-led airstrikes on Yemen Hodeidah port
properties.summary: Saudi airstrikes targeted Hodeidah port July 25. Al-Mayadeen reports Saudi forces conducted strikes.

properties.title: Attack on Khormur gas field, Sulaymaniyah
properties.summary: Reports of attack on Khormur gas field in Sulaymaniyah province, Iraq July 28.

properties.title: Israeli strike in Hadatha, Lebanon
properties.summary: Explosion carried out by Israeli army in town of Hadatha reported July 29.

properties.title: Kuwaiti border crossing attacked by drones
properties.summary: Kuwaiti Army: Al-Abdali border crossing with Iraq attacked by drones July 23.
